lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Reward: Pilgrim Field Tent Voucher ×2

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Thank you, thank you!

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I got the medal that you sent.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: This should shut up those fools

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: who doubt my past achievements.
I have something to ask.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: By all means.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Don't be shy, ask me anything.
That stuff about being a Commander 10 years ago, is it true?
Is this really your medal?

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: What makes you ask?
This medal is much older.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Uh-huh,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: and just how would you know that?
Cross-shaped medals stopped being issued 20 years ago.
There is a long silence from Cervan.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I do come from the Sovereign class, that much is true.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Your superior from way up high is my Father.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Everyone knows that once someone with that much power

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: sets their mind on something,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: they'll be able to accomplish it.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: So, I put my power and prestige to good use

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: to locate an old medal that was lying around gathering dust.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Where's the harm in that?

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: We all profited from this arrangement, including you.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: After all, you're being rewarded handsomely for your part in all this.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I would like to thank you again,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: and if there are any other requests in the future, I will contact you again.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: You've done a commendable job here.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Until then,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: stay safe.
